explain_cert_has.zh: 第三方实地验厂，验证了经营资质和运营状态。
explain_cert_has.en: Third-party on-site factory audit, verifying business qualifications and operational status.
explain_cert_has.vi: Kiểm toán nhà máy tại chỗ bởi bên thứ ba, xác minh trình độ kinh doanh và tình trạng hoạt động.
explain_cert_has.th: การตรวจโรงงานหน้างานโดยบุคคลที่สาม ตรวจสอบคุณสมบัติธุรกิจและสถานะการดำเนินงาน.

explain_cert_none.zh: 该供应商未展示第三方认证。建议取样后确认质量。
explain_cert_none.en: This supplier has not displayed third-party certification. Suggest confirming quality after sampling.
explain_cert_none.vi: Nhà cung cấp này chưa hiển thị chứng nhận bên thứ ba. Nên xác nhận chất lượng sau khi lấy mẫu.
explain_cert_none.th: ซัพพลายเออร์นี้ยังไม่แสดงการรับรองจากบุคคลที่สาม. แนะนำยืนยันคุณภาพหลังจากสั่งตัวอย่าง.

explain_company_name.zh: 政府注册的法定名称，可在企业信用系统中验证。
explain_company_name.en: Government-registered legal name, verifiable in the enterprise credit system.
explain_company_name.vi: Tên pháp lý đã đăng ký chính phủ, có thể xác minh trong hệ thống tín dụng doanh nghiệp.
explain_company_name.th: ชื่อตามกฎหมายที่จดทะเบียนกับรัฐบาล ตรวจสอบได้ในระบบเครดิตองค์กร

explain_flags_flagship.zh: 1688 现货品类旗舰店。价格有竞争力。可放心采购；建议取样确认。
explain_flags_flagship.en: 1688 flagship in ready-stock category. Competitive pricing. Can purchase with confidence; suggest sample confirmation.
explain_flags_flagship.vi: 1688 flagship trong danh mục hàng có sẵn. Giá cạnh tranh. Có thể mua tự tin; nên xác nhận mẫu.
explain_flags_flagship.th: 1688 เรือธงในหมวดสินค้าพร้อมส่ง. ราคาแข่งขันได้. มั่นใจในการซื้อ; แนะนำยืนยันตัวอย่าง.

explain_flags_self_claimed.zh: 自行宣称工厂，无 1688 深度验厂。建议先取样验证产线和质量。
explain_flags_self_claimed.en: Self-claimed factory without 1688 advanced audit. Suggest sampling first to verify production line and quality.
explain_flags_self_claimed.vi: Tự xưng nhà máy không có kiểm toán nâng cao 1688. Nên lấy mẫu trước để xác minh dây chuyền và chất lượng.
explain_flags_self_claimed.th: อ้างตัวเป็นโรงงานโดยไม่มีการตรวจขั้นสูงของ 1688. แนะนำสั่งตัวอย่างก่อนเพื่อตรวจสอบสายการผลิตและคุณภาพ.

explain_flags_shili.zh: 1688 官方验厂（系统更新中）。产能稳定 + 基础质检。建议取样试用。
explain_flags_shili.en: 1688 official factory audit (system updating). Stable production capacity + basic QC. Suggest sample trial.
explain_flags_shili.vi: Kiểm toán nhà máy chính thức 1688 (hệ thống đang cập nhật). Năng lực sản xuất ổn định + QC cơ bản. Nên thử mẫu.
explain_flags_shili.th: การตรวจโรงงานอย่างเป็นทางการของ 1688 (ระบบกำลังอัปเดต). กำลังการผลิตเสถียร + QC พื้นฐาน. แนะนำทดลองตัวอย่าง.

explain_flags_super.zh: 1688 最高级别验厂认证。自有产线，从小批量试单到大货均可承接。
explain_flags_super.en: 1688 highest-level factory audit certification. Own production line, handles small trials to bulk orders.
explain_flags_super.vi: Chứng nhận kiểm toán cấp cao nhất 1688. Dây chuyền sản xuất riêng, nhận từ đơn nhỏ đến số lượng lớn.
explain_flags_super.th: การรับรองตรวจโรงงานระดับสูงสุดของ 1688. มีสายการผลิตของตัวเอง รับตั้งแต่ออเดอร์ทดลองถึงจำนวนมาก.

explain_flags_trader.zh: 贸易商无自有工厂产能；货物来自第三方供应商。
explain_flags_trader.en: Trader has no in-house factory capacity; goods sourced from third-party suppliers.
explain_flags_trader.vi: Thương nhân không có năng lực sản xuất; hàng lấy từ nhà cung cấp bên thứ ba.
explain_flags_trader.th: ผู้ค้าไม่มีกำลังการผลิตของตนเอง; สินค้ามาจากซัพพลายเออร์บุคคลที่สาม.

explain_seller_factory.vi: Nhà sản xuất được 1688 xác minh, có năng lực sản xuất độc lập.

summary_conditional_ok.zh: 货能卖、厂也能用，可以试。先拿样验质量，再谈批量

summary_conditional_careful.zh: 两边都有短板，悠着点。先少量试、盯紧质量，别急着铺量
summary_conditional_careful.en: Both sides have weak spots — go easy. Start small, watch quality closely, don't rush to scale.

summary_conditional_factory_strong.zh: 厂靠得住，但品还没完全验证。先少量拿，卖动了厂能跟上
summary_conditional_factory_strong.en: Supplier is solid, but the product isn't fully proven. Start small — once it moves, the factory can keep up.

summary_conditional_supplier_weak.zh: 品没问题。但厂拖后腿——拿样验货，确认质量再批量
summary_conditional_supplier_weak.en: Product's fine, but the supplier drags it down — sample and inspect, confirm quality before bulk.

summary_go_both.zh: 品验证过，厂靠得住。拿样确认，可以放心做
summary_go_both.en: Product's proven, supplier checks out. Sample it to confirm, then go with confidence.

summary_go_product_ok.zh: 品没问题。厂基本面OK但缺顶级背书——拿样时多留个心眼验货
summary_go_product_ok.en: Product's fine. Supplier fundamentals are OK but lack top-tier backing — inspect carefully when sampling.

prod_verdict_go_repurchase.zh: 值得做。有销量打底（{sold}件）+ 买过的人会回来补货（{repurchase}%复购）——品稳、有需求。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_go_repurchase.en: Worth doing. Sales volume backs it up ({sold} units) and buyers come back to restock ({repurchase}% repurchase) — the product holds up and demand is there. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_go_hot_wanted.zh: 值得做。卖得火（{sold}件）+ 当前热度高（{wanted}人想看）——需求被两次验证过。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_go_hot_wanted.en: Worth doing. Selling hot ({sold} units) with strong current interest ({wanted} want-buys) — demand verified twice over. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_go_hot_repeat.zh: 值得做。热销（{sold}件）+ 有复购（{repurchase}%）——卖得动且有人回头。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_go_hot_repeat.en: Worth doing. Hot seller ({sold} units) with repeat buyers ({repurchase}%) — it moves and people come back. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_trial_hot_unknown.zh: 小批量试。卖得火（{sold}件）但复购数据缺失——不确定买过的人会不会回来。先少量拿，卖动了再追。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_trial_hot_unknown.en: Test with a small batch. Selling hot ({sold} units) but repurchase data is missing — unsure if buyers come back. Start small, scale if it keeps moving. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_trial_wanted_low.zh: 小批量试。很多人想看（{wanted}人）但还没怎么卖（{sold}件）——需求在但没被验证。拿少量试水。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_trial_wanted_low.en: Test with a small batch. Lots of interest ({wanted} want-buys) but low sales so far ({sold} units) — demand is there but unproven. Order a small trial. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_trial_rep_low.zh: 值得试。复购率高（{repurchase}%）说明产品被反复验证过——不是一次性冲动消费。虽然当前销量少（{sold}件），但门槛低，拿样试错基本不亏。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_trial_rep_low.en: Worth trying. High repurchase ({repurchase}%) means the product has been re-validated — not a one-time impulse buy. Sales are low ({sold} units) but the barrier is low, so sampling is basically risk-free. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_trial_medium3.zh: 小批量试。{highlight_count}个维度有亮点——有支撑但不够强。少量试试。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_trial_medium3.en: Test with a small batch. {highlight_count} dimensions show promise — enough to support it, not enough to go all in. Try a little. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_caution_hot_low.zh: 谨慎。卖得火（{sold}件）但复购仅{repurchase}%——可能是冲动消费或一次性款。先小批试，卖得动再追。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_caution_hot_low.en: Be careful. Hot seller ({sold} units) but only {repurchase}% repurchase — could be impulse buys or a one-off. Start small, scale only if it keeps moving. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_caution_rep_low.zh: 谨慎。复购高（{repurchase}%）但销量少（{sold}件）——复购好但客户群还小。先拿样测需求。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_caution_rep_low.en: Be careful. High repurchase ({repurchase}%) but low sales ({sold} units) — loyal buyers but a small base. Sample first to test demand. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_watch_medium12.zh: 观望。仅有{highlight_count}个维度有亮点——撑不起来。先收藏蹲数据，别急着下手。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_watch_medium12.en: Hold off. Only {highlight_count} dimension(s) show promise — not enough to build on. Save it and wait for more data. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}

prod_verdict_watch_flat.zh: 观望。全维度平平——没看到足够亮点。先收藏蹲数据。{barrier_tip}{risk_note}
prod_verdict_watch_flat.en: Hold off. Nothing stands out across the board — no strong signals yet. Save it and wait for more data. {barrier_tip}{risk_note}
